```{r}
#| label: setup
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(parsnip)
library(broom)

# Load Louisiana wide dataset
data_path <- if (file.exists("data/clean/louisiana_wide_clean.csv")) {
  "data/clean/louisiana_wide_clean.csv"
} else {
  "../data/clean/louisiana_wide_clean.csv"
}

la_wide <- read_csv(data_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c("pre_ban", "post_ban")))

# Fit linear regression model
linear_reg() |>
  set_engine("lm") |>
  fit(g3_12_math ~ period, data = la_wide) |>
  tidy(conf.int = TRUE) |>
  select(term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high)
```
